# **iatai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** ## **REF: IRDA/INT/IMF/CIR/ /09/2015** **16 September, 2015** ### ### ### applications for issuance of No Objection Certificate (NOC) to be submitted to Registrar of Companies (RoC) for getting registration. Vide Reg. 5.2 (vi) of the IMF Regulations; the applicant shall have the words "Insurance Marketing Firm" in its name. It is noted that Rule 8 of Companies Incorporation Rules, 2014 issued by Ministry of Corporate Affairs under Companies Act, 2013, a proposed company name with 'Firm' is undesirable _as it indicates separate type of business constitution or legal_ In view of the above, it is hereby clarified that the proposed name shall not be inconsistent with the above Rule and as such, the word "Firm" need not be there _in_ name of the company while registering with RoC. ### ~ '9'ft:WJ ,:rcr;r, ~ITT.9, isl~ft(~ll'I, ~-500 004. ® _=_ 91-040-2330 1100, m: 91-040-6682 3334 Parisharam Bhavan, 3rd Floor, Basheer Bagh, Hyderabad-500 004.
